note: redactSecrets(text) — AC5050. Node's own cases (server/test/onboarding-domain.test.ts) plus YAML block scalars, CRLF, embedded JSON pairs, env references, benign max_tokens and JS-vs-RE2 corner cases. Strings use \u{HEX}; '${' is written as \u{24}{ so that no corpus string looks like an interpolation.
